subject: Final recommendation: Outreach vs Salesloft bake-off + procurement next steps
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Final recommendation: Outreach vs Salesloft bake-off + procurement next steps

Team —

Thanks for running the last two weeks of demos and pilot testing. Attached is the consolidated bake-off scoring and the raw notes from the SDR and AE sessions (bakeoff-scoring-20260914.csv). High level: Outreach won on sequencing flexibility and prefix caching we care about for our outbound volume; Salesloft scored higher for CRM sync and native Salesforce activity logging.

We need a procurement decision by end of week to lock pricing before Outreach's promotional discount window closes (they flagged 10/1 as the last day). Please respond with:
- your vendor recommendation (Outreach or Salesloft) and 1–2 rationale bullets,
- target committed seat count for year 1,
- any non-negotiable terms or redlines (data residency, activity retention, audit logs),
- confirm if you want me to drive commercial/negotiation with vendors or hand to Legal/Finance.

I'm attaching the vendor spreadsheets and the internal scoring.

Attachments: outreach_pricing_2026.pdf (pricing worksheet), salesloft_feature_matrix.xlsx (feature mapping)

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final recommendation: Outreach vs Salesloft bake-off + procurement next steps

Thanks Grace — read the pack this morning. Short version from GTM: recommend Outreach as primary with a 1-year contract and option to revisit at 9 months. Key reasons:
- sequencing & playbook controls matched our high-personalization outbound (reduced manual ops).
- Outreach's KV cache and streaming connectors reduced token costs in our pilot by ~15%.

Proposed seats: 120 SDR + 40 AEs (we're consolidating legacy accounts into a single seat pool). Non-negotiables: SOC 2 attestation, event retention of 1 year, ability to export activity logs (S3 delivery).

I'll volunteer to lead vendor conversations on product fit and pilot outcomes. Finance should run pricing/procurement.

Best — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Appreciate the summary. From a cost perspective I need: confirmed committed seat counts (Marissa's numbers are a good start), ARR vs monthly billing options, and any volume discounts or credits for migration (we will need a one-time migration assistance line item). My preliminary modelling based on Outreach's worksheet shows: list price ~ $1.1M for year 1 for the seats Marissa suggested; with a 20% promotional discount (their current window) we're ~ $880k. Please push vendor to confirm the discount in writing and the length of the promotional term.

Redlines that will materially impact price: minimum term (we prefer 12 months but will consider 24 for better pricing), data export SLA, and indemnity language. Legal needs to see their standard MSA.

I can pre-approve negotiation ranges if you send the target seat counts and whether we convert legacy seats (that affects true-up timing).

Thanks — Aditya

Subject: Outreach commercial terms and limited-time incentive

Grace / Marissa / team —

Thanks for the time during the bake-off. Quick follow-up with a short term offer: Outreach can confirm a 20% first-year discount for an executed agreement by 2026-10-01 and will include one week of migration assistance (remote) plus a $10k credit for professional services if you commit to 12+ months at the seat counts you shared. I've attached the pricing worksheet we referenced.

High level on compliance: Outreach is SOC 2 Type II, supports S3 push for logs, and offers configurable retention windows. We'll provide a copy of our MSA upon request — I'll loop in legal if you'd like.

Attachment: outreach_pricing_2026.pdf
Link to signature: https://app.docusign.com/containers/12345678

Subject: Procurement plan & legal handoff

Team —

Given Outreach's confirmed 20% incentive and the migration credit, my recommendation is:
1) Pursue Outreach for the immediate consolidation (120 SDR + 40 AE) on a 12-month term; get the 20% locked in with DocuSign.
2) Legal to review Outreach MSA for data residency and indemnity redlines. I will prep a standard PO and SOW for migration work.
3) Keep Salesloft as a fallback vendor (we'll close the pilot but pause procurement).

Actions:
- Marissa: confirm final seat list and any legacy seats to convert by Fri EOD (2026-09-18).
- Aditya: confirm approval range for negotiation (we need to know max discount tolerance / cap on concessions).
- Grace: if you can approve Outreach to proceed to commercial negotiations, I'll open vendor intake and loop Legal.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-bakeoff-report (scoring and raw notes), HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765
